root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: At `case FILE_FACTOR_OP_NONE`, `parse_strength()` must leave `l` unchanged instead of falling through to `m->factor_op = *l++;`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When the empty `!:strength` payload reaches `case FILE_FACTOR_OP_NONE`, the parser must break out of the switch with `l` still at the terminating NUL byte.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable switch falls through from `case FILE_FACTOR_OP_NONE` into `m->factor_op = *l++;`, so the empty-payload path advances `l` one byte past the logical end of the string before later `%s` formatting. The fixed original reaches the same case but leaves `l` unchanged.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink, `file_magwarn()` reaches `vfprintf(stderr, f, va)` with the `Bad factor` `%s` string argument still present in the varargs list, so C-string formatting dereferences that pointer.

edges.relation: The same pointer value produced by the `m->factor_op = *l++;` fallthrough path is forwarded unchanged as the first `%s` string argument that `file_magwarn()` passes to `vfprintf()`.
